---
title: "Hirotaka Fukui"     
title-block-style: none      
---

Sometimes everything begins to come apart.

And by the time I realize it, everything has already gone so terribly wrong that nothing can be undone.

When I needed it most, where was the passion that was supposed to keep me alive?

When I needed it most, where was the moment that was supposed to save me?

My life has been drifting farther and farther from where it was ever meant to be.

Every time something happens, another part of me breaks.

Again and again, I fall apart.

You do not understand.

You do not know what I have lost, or how much of me has already collapsed.

And you never will.

You never knew.

You never understood.

And now there is nothing left for you to understand.
